prompt: Mike, an experienced system administrator, is updating an LDAP user's password. He wants to use ldappasswd and also wants to ensure that he's prompted for the old password before setting a new one. Which command should he execute to achieve this?
explanation: The ldappasswd tool allows administrators to modify an LDAP user's password. By using the -A option, Mike will be prompted for the old password before he's allowed to set a new one, ensuring that only those who know the current password can change it.
